adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a new `raw_html` cook path (`Post#cook`) that returns `raw` directly when `cook_method == :raw_html`, bypassing the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline and plugin filters. `Jobs::PollFeed` passes `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` into `TopicEmbed.import`, which stores it via `PostCreator` with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (and `skip_validations: true`), and `app/views/embed/best.html.erb` renders it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. There is no tag/attribute whitelist or sanitizer applied in this path (and `CGI.unescapeHTML` can re-enable escaped HTML), so a malicious/compromised feed or source content can result in stored script execution in the embedded output.
